current_design_requirement: The only runnable filesystem Decoupled DiLoCo product is named Full Protocol; product modules, public types, config entry points, schema files, durable run paths, protocol labels, CLI help, tests, and current documentation contain no v4 generation suffix.
verification: Repository-wide tracked-source scan plus import/CLI/config/schema/path tests.

current_design_requirement: One strict Config type and load_config/resolve_config/write_resolved_config API own the complete Full Protocol configuration. Shared-envelope projection, profiles, migration helpers, aliases, and old key fallbacks do not exist.
verification: Focused config parser/resolver tests cover valid static/dynamic configs and unknown/removed inputs.

current_design_requirement: Fresh static and dynamic runs use unversioned schema.sql and schema_dynamic.sql with one current authority initializer and bootstrap marker/layout.
verification: DDL bootstrap and identity tests for both membership modes; repository scan rejects versioned schema and run paths.

current_design_requirement: Legacy readers/configs, migration paths, second runnable baselines, superseded evidence utilities, dead wrappers, unused dependencies, stale scripts/configs/docs, and compatibility-only branches are deleted.
verification: Tracked-file and import graph scan; package entry-point resolution tests; ruff unused/dead-surface checks.

current_design_requirement: The retained Full Protocol has one dependency direction and one writer for configuration, descriptor, authority, admission/control, learner, syncer, merge/publication, terminal, and cleanup behavior.
verification: Architecture boundary tests and full current-state review.

current_design_requirement: Every retained module has a focused unit or static contract test at its public behavior boundary; tests describe only the current design.
verification: Requirement-to-test inventory reports every retained module as covered or justified data-only; complete suite passes on one compute node.

current_design_requirement: The integration harness has independently tested argument parsing, source/config/PBS identity, artifact schema/result projection, expected failure classification, terminal authority oracles, and cleanup dry-run before any multi-node run.
verification: Focused harness unit tests plus test-design review.

current_design_requirement: A real 4 learner + 1 syncer Full Protocol run proves initialization, admission, training, receipt/proposal ingest, selection, merge/publication, adoption, exact token accounting, terminal drain, and integrity.
verification: Five-node structured checker validates durable SQLite authority, immutable publications, four contributor identities, exact workload, terminal acknowledgements, ledger balance zero, and integrity_check=ok.

current_design_requirement: The reviewed 4+1 scenarios prove the implemented node-state fault boundaries: learner process replacement is fenced and makes progress, and syncer leader failure/takeover preserves a single durable writer without duplicate merge/publication.
verification: Pre-registered process/PBS fault injection; successor fence/epoch and authority rows are durable oracles; exit codes and logs are diagnostic only.

current_design_requirement: One clean frozen commit completes a Miyabi 8 learner + 1 syncer experiment with exactly 50 local optimizer steps per learner cycle and exactly 10 committed global steps.
verification: Nine-node checker validates topology, resolved workload, ten committed successors, contributor participation, processed/direct-token accounting, terminal state, immutable object hashes, source fingerprint, and SQLite integrity.

current_design_requirement: README and docs describe only the retained unversioned implementation, config, paths, commands, testing, operations, and verified 9-node result; all links and named files exist.
verification: Documentation path/link/name scan plus final evidence review.

current_design_requirement: The requirement matrix is 100% bound to same-target evidence, all blocking findings are closed, artifacts are evidence-bound and cleaned, and plan/report are archived with an evidence-path mapping.
verification: Completed checker plus plan-complete current-state and final-evidence reviews.
